$comment: What the converter (scripts/migrate/html-to-astro.cjs) does not reduce to the shared components and the trainer template. `pages`: pages it refuses to generate unless --force is passed; with --force the blocks listed in `keep` stay in the page as markup, and their map iframes and app-badge markers still become components. `trainers.legacy`: differences between the legacy trainer pages that are markup, not content; each is a field of the collection entry (src/content/trainers/*.json, mostly in its `legacy` block) and is listed here with the reason and the entries that carry it. `--all` fails when this list and the generated entries disagree. `since` is the legacy base SHA an entry was recorded against.

/klubnaya-karta/.reason: Own menu (an logo, aria-label, rel on the map link, no Webflow node ids) and own footer (wrapped in div#contacts.club-card-contacts, opening hours with an en dash, rel on the legal links, phone heading on one line); GTM comments use single spaces and the noscript iframe carries a title. Menu.astro and Footer.astro are not applied.

markup=webflow.reason: Pages exported from Webflow: the GTM noscript frame follows webflow.js in the body tail.

markup=handwritten.reason: Pages written by hand after the export: a blank line precedes the menu, and the GTM noscript frame stands in the page body before jQuery, followed by a blank line.

webflowComments.reason: Webflow export comments after the doctype; the publication date differs between the two families, and the page of Efim has none.

gtm.reason: GTM loader in the head and GTM noscript frame in the body without the surrounding comments.

backFallbackPath.reason: The back button falls back to /trenery/ instead of / when the tab has no history.

ctaRegularSpace.reason: The sign-up button separates «к» and the name with a regular space; the other pages use a non-breaking space.

certificateIndent.reason: Certificate cards are indented by twelve spaces instead of six.

certificateLinkRel.reason: Certificate links carry rel="noopener noreferrer" and no aria-label; the other pages carry aria-label="Посмотреть документ" and no rel.

certificates.plainDescription.reason: The description of the first certificate is not wrapped in <strong class="bold-text-2">.

certificatesSectionEmpty.reason: An empty <section class="section-2"> stands between the list and the divider; the page has no certificates.
